description: This file defines a generic class 'StreamCheckpoint<TState>' used for managing stream processing checkpoints in Orleans, including properties for stream identifiers, tokens, and methods for duplicate detection and token updates.

classes.name: StreamCheckpoint<TState>
classes.description: A serializable class representing a checkpoint in an Orleans stream, tracking stream identifiers, tokens, and processing state.

methods.name: RecoveryToken
methods.description: A property that returns the last processed token or the start token if none processed.

methods.name: IsDuplicate
methods.description: Determines if a given sequence token is a duplicate based on the last processed token and start token.

methods.name: TryUpdateStartToken
methods.description: Attempts to set the start token if it is currently null.
